text:
If you've got Sunday plans on the water or in the yard, today's the one to use, because Monday brings the front back into play. Those morning showers clear out, and Burlington swings into a genuinely nice afternoon: sunny, a high right around 85, and lighter humidity than we've had lately. Light southwest wind, nothing to plan around. The lake's in good shape too, south winds 5 to 15 knots easing toward northwest by evening, waves a foot or less, water sitting at a swimmable 78. Models mostly agree on today, though Euro and ICON are hinting at better shower odds than GFS, so don't be shocked by a passing sprinkle.

Monday's the one to watch. NWS has a 50-60% chance of showers and storms moving in by afternoon and lingering into the evening, and the lake forecast backs that up with gusty south winds near 30 knots by then, worth being off the water well before that arrives. Tonight stays easy, partly cloudy and comfortable near 65. Good outdoor evening tonight and a clean window for Sunday, but I'd have Monday's afternoon plans indoors or flexible.
